oracleProfile.reason: Default JIT tiers and --no-opt produced different NaN bits for identical source and inputs. --jitless was stable across all six cold/warmed probe processes.
oracleProfile.throughputPolicy: Performance measurements may use compiled native candidates or separately identified runtime flags. Qualification compares candidate traces against this pinned source profile; measurements alone do not establish equivalence.
oracleProfile.scope: Reproducible reference implementation profile, not a claim that ECMAScript specifies NaN sign/payload or that all engine versions produce identical bits.

conclusion: Original Skill.rebuildPhaseList adds Type=Attack to the shared table row and retains that same object in skill phase event lists. Preserve table mutation and alias identity; neither a read-only table nor a copied event row is faithful.
